messages:
Emma S.: FYI — Customer 'GloboTrade EU' just pinged procurement. AP rejected our invoice PDF citing missing VAT number and that the PO isn't in the header, they said 'cannot process'. BillingBot: payment attempt failed earlier (card_declined, code=4021) — customer then retried with a different card which succeeded, but AP sees two attempts and flagged duplicate invoice. Raj P.: Ugh. Do we have a copy of the PDF they received? which template generated it? Emma S.: Attached the PDF from our outgoing-s3 link (internal). Template = invoice_v2.html -> I think we only populate "Bill To" and put PO in the footer. Customer requires PO number in the top-right header and "Legal entity name + VAT" in the header as well. Lin H.: Can we confirm which fields our invoice payload sets? Usually we send payload like: ```json { "customer": { "name": "GloboTrade EU", "legal_entity": "Redwood Inference, Inc.", "vat_id": "" }, "billing": { "po_number": "", "terms": "net30" }, "line_items": [ { "desc": "Inference hours", "amount": 123.45, "tax": 0 } ] } ``` Emma S.: Example from their AP rejection: "Missing VAT ID for supplier (EU)" and "PO not in invoice header". They also want per-line VAT breakdown when VAT applies. Zoe A.: For EU customers we must include VAT ID and VAT breakdown. If customer is a B2B intra-EU supplier they often need VAT on header and line items set to 0 or show reverse-charge note. For GloboTrade they insisted on supplier VAT present. Raj P.: Action items: 1) Add legal_entity.vat_id to header on PDF if present in payload. 2) Move PO number from footer to header (top-right) when po_number is present. 3) If tax per line exists, show a column for VAT% and tax amount. 4) De-duplicate payment attempts in AP note — add payment_attempt_id to invoice PDF metadata. Lin H.: I can change the template mapping. Quick patch suggestion (jinja snippet): ```html
{{ customer.name }}
{{ customer.legal_entity }}
{% if customer.vat_id %}VAT: {{ customer.vat_id }}{% endif %}
{% if billing.po_number %}PO: {{ billing.po_number }}{% endif %}
Invoice #: {{ invoice.number }}
``` Emma S.: Perfect — can we also include a small note for reverse-charge: "Reverse-charge may apply — customer to self-account for VAT" when country != issuer country and vat_id missing? Zoe A.: Yes. For EU sales without supplier VAT we need that note. But if supplier VAT exists, show it clearly with registration country. Raj P.: Also: our API should validate before sending PDF: if customer.country in EU && customer.legal_entity_country == "EU" && !customer.vat_id then flag warning in dashboard and add note to invoice: 'VAT missing — may be rejected by AP'. Put a non-blocking error in the invoice metadata so Support can see it. BillingBot: payment event log: {"event":"payment_failed","code":4021,"attempts":1,"timestamp":"2025-11-02T10:12:34Z"} then {"event":"payment_succeeded","attempts":2,"timestamp":"2025-11-02T10:13:12Z"}. Lin H.: I'll make the template change and push to the staging branch. Can someone add a simple QA checklist for AP acceptance? Things to include: legal entity name, full registered address (street + city + postal + country), VAT/Tax ID (if provided), PO number in header, per-line tax column if tax > 0, payment reference / attempt id. Emma S.: I'll add the checklist to the ticket and reach back to the customer with a corrected PDF. Also will ask AP for their preferred XML/CSV EDI if they want machine-readable invoices. Raj P.: Thanks. One more: ensure mult-entity billing paths map the right legal_entity for the customer's contract. We've seen invoices generated under the wrong vendor shortname causing AP to reject. Zoe A.: Noted. Lin — please include a sample invoice JSON payload in the PR description so QA can simulate AP's parser. Lin H.: Will do. ETA for staging PR: today EOD. ETA to prod: tomorrow morning if no blockers. Emma S.: Great — I'll hold the escalation open until production patch and confirm with customer. :thumbsup:
